description: This file defines the 'Forgotten' controller class for the Account module in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It manages user account password recovery features such as displaying the forgotten password page, confirming a password reset request, resetting the password, and updating the password. The class interacts with models, views, and session data to facilitate the password recovery process.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class handling forgot password functionality, including rendering views, processing password reset requests, and token validation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the forgot password page with breadcrumbs and common layout components.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes password reset confirmation, generates tokens, and responds with JSON, handling user email submission.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles the display of the password reset form, validating reset tokens, and preparing view data.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Processes the new password submission, validates password strength, updates the user password, and manages session tokens.
